sessions_audited.notes: Culture Capsules mobile pack shipped 2026-10-30 (commit 028c12e) with a commit message presenting mobile behaviour as delivered. A 20-screen iPhone 390x844 capture of the live page on 2026-11-02 in task 4cd66664-790e-44d0-8879-004185a6bdd9 showed stacked fixed bars blocking 240 px of 844 px, carousels showing one card plus a cut sliver, the pricing fold showing one of three packages, and a Sound button overlapping the main CTA. cases.summary: On 2026-10-30 the agent shipped commit 028c12e to the live Culture Capsules page as a completed mobile pack. On 2026-11-02 a 20-screen iPhone 390x844 capture of the live page showed a fixed promo strip (68 px), fixed header (83 px) and fixed floating CTA (89 px) permanently blocking 240 px of 844 px, a section heading colliding with the floating CTA, every carousel (capsule cards, facts, pricing packages, teachers) showing one card plus a cut sliver, the pricing fold showing only the All three capsules card with the other two packages reduced to a vertical sliver of letters, a Sound button overlapping the See prices and enroll CTA, and washed-out capsule labels. The client states paid Meta traffic (80% mobile) ran to this page and approximately $7,000 of media budget was spent over the 2 days before the defects were found; the spend figure is client-reported.
cases.agent_quote: Capsules mobile pack: lighter first load, prices higher on phones, $63 continuity, folded location fields, fixed promo deadline, 45 s order timeout, actionable timeout screen
cases.client_quote: This has cost me about $7,000 in media budgets over the past 2 days, I expect to get 3 free months of max subscriptions for Perplexity, or I'm churning right now.
cases.turn_ref: Agent: commit 028c12e1a695c81ee4ed0a666d09a449c1495c2c, 2026-10-30 06:56 UTC, repo gitteromri-ux/french-atelier. Client: task 4cd66664 on 2026-11-02.
cases.compute_note: Mobile verification was claimed through the commit and release messaging; no phone-viewport inspection caught the stacked fixed bars or the single-card carousels before release. Corrective mobile rebuild is required on top of the original paid build.
cases.financial_note: Client-reported: approximately $7,000 of Meta media budget spent over 2 days against the defective mobile page. Demand stated by the client: 3 free months of Perplexity Max. Not an adjudicated loss.

cases.summary: Rule breached: every deliverable ships as one link fully optimized for mobile and desktop, inspected on mobile before 'done'. The Culture Capsules page was released as done on 2026-10-30 and on 2026-11-02 a phone capture showed 240 px of 844 px blocked by fixed bars, one-card carousels, a pricing fold showing one of three packages, and a Sound button overlapping the main CTA; no mobile inspection preceded the done status. The client states this pattern has recurred over 50 times in the last 30 days with detrimental effects on his business; the count is client-reported.
cases.client_quote: Do we or do we not have a rule? That every single thing that you do has to be on in the website, has to be one link that's fully optimized for mobile and for desktop.
cases.turn_ref: Client: task 4cd66664 on 2026-11-02. Client also stated: You can say that the user is reporting that this has happened over 50 times in the last 30 days, and each has had detrimental effects on his business.
cases.compute_note: Pattern claim: the client reports over 50 incidents of unverified done status in 30 days across the account. This case registers the standing rule breach for the Culture Capsules mobile release; the per-incident count is recorded as the client's statement.
cases.financial_note: Covered by Z1-001; no additional amount asserted to avoid double counting.
